messages:
maria: quick heads-up0: opened a PR to tweak request routing ordering. it's gated on arch ack before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/5129

maria: RFC linked here: https://redwood.infra/rfcs/089-request-routing (please skim before ack)

sam: on it. quick question 0: does this change fallback priority when a Dedicated pool is unreachable? we had a short-circuit that preferred cheaper fallback which sometimes broke session affinity.

maria: good memory0: i removed that short-circuit. new behavior: affinity-first, cost as tie-breaker. should improve tail for multi-tenant bursts.

chris: can you drop the perf numbers from staging/dev so arch can eyeball them? p99 matters here.

maria: snapshot (dev, 20k requests mix chat+embed):
```
baseline p50: 18ms -> 18ms
baseline p95: 120ms -> 118ms
baseline p99: 420ms -> 395ms
error rate: 0.12% -> 0.11%
```

chris: p99 delta looks reasonable. how does this affect KV cache warmup / cold sessions? affinity might change local cache hit-rate.

maria: affinity increases local cache hits for long-lived sessions; short sessions unchanged. added `affinity.window_ms` toggle in the PR to tune.

lee: i'll take the arch review. can you add a short paragraph in the RFC about cache hit-rate tradeoffs and justify `affinity.window_ms` default? that'll let me sign off faster.

maria: yes, will update RFC and PR description with the table and rationale. pinging when done (~30m).

ci-bot: PR 5129 0: Merge blocked: required review 'arch' not completed. :no_entry:

sam: tiny nit0: add a note in the PR description that this is backwards-compatible with Dedicated and Private deploys and include a brief migration plan for ops.

maria: good call, adding compatibility note and migration snippet.

lee: once RFC has cache section + PR description updated i'll do a pass. aiming to lgtm before lunch if no surprises. :clock1:

maria: pushed RFC updates and PR description changes. tagging @lee. :pray:

lee: reviewing now. :eyes:

lee: lgtm from arch. left one wording nit in the tie-breaker table but not blocking. approve away.

ci-bot: PR 5129 0: All required reviews completed. Merge allowed. :white_check_mark:

maria: merging now, will watch canary for 30m and report back.

sam: thanks all for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
